scenario: AITA for shutting down conversation about babies? | Recently, my good friend (let’s call her B) was in town visiting and we went out for drinks at a fancy new bar with another friend of hers (let’s call her M), who I’d only met once before. B went with her to settle the tab and make sure M found a Lyft, and then came back. Am I an ass? It was my only chance to catch up with my friend and I wanted to keep the mood light, but the evening was ruined.
